title: DEVAI Adopter Policy
description: Validated adopter-owned policy source merged into DEVAI's resolved project configuration without replacing core policy domains.

docs.description: Documentation configuration uses the same closed shape accepted by the resolved adopter project configuration.

ci_economy.description: Optional CI-economy policy materialized into the adopter project configuration.

authority.description: Optional adopter path-authority extension admitted by Constitution 1.0.2 Article 6 (ADR-GOV-0024) and declared by ADR-AUT-0003: explicitly declared roots under a fixed class ladder, architecture over test over the Engineer root remainder. Materialized only through init bind --adopter-policy and refused while the bound constitution is below 1.0.2.

extension_id.description: Identifier of the compiled additive extension; defaults to <policy_id>.path-authority and must differ from devai-adopter-authority.

roots.description: Single path segments declared explicitly: no separator, no dot segment, no glob metacharacter, never equal to or a prefix of a core-table row, and no root a prefix of another.

classes.description: The two path classes of the fixed ladder. test is optional and defaults to the package selectors in law/policy/adopter-defaults/path-authority-classes.json; architecture has no default.

test.description: Inspector class at precedence 700: test directories and colocated test files under each root.

selectors.description: Root-relative minimatch globs applied under every declared root; never absolute, never starting with a root segment, and free of .., backslashes, braces, and extglobs.

architecture.description: Architect class at precedence 750: schema definitions, blueprints, and the architectural specifications the adopter names under each root.

selectors.description: Root-relative minimatch globs applied under every declared root; never absolute, never starting with a root segment, and free of .., backslashes, braces, and extglobs.
